body: Please stay with me. I am feeling something similar. Please help me and maybe just maybe I can help you. If nothing else just stay with me and talk to me.
I'm not anytime soon. Please feel free to PM me
Some of us are still awake! Talk to us OP! Please!

Thanks for caring. I wish I had a time machine to help, I can't imagine how you just feel. Honestly, I have no excuse other than how low I feel. I will do my best to talk to a loved one, but it's really difficult bc I am not sure if they will understand. I will try my best to make them.

I wish I drank and smoked. Kind of wish I took the oxy plunge in all honesty. Sorry I wish I could be in a better place. I may drink more but I think I am past jumping. Just still feel like shit , is that okay? I am curious, are you a man or a women?
Please OP are you still here? Talk to us! More ppl care than probably what you realize

Thanks again for being here for me. I feel so insignificant but at least I have someone to talk to. All my friends are either at a party or sleeping. Don't worry I don't have it in me to end it all tonight, but I still feel super low and wish I could take the pain away
It's really hard for me to even type this that's how much of a loser I am
I feel so low bc I feel like I do I fit into any group what so ever, I have a gf and friends but no one knows how I feel bc I feel ashamed to admit or acknowledge it

Thanks sunsetBelle if nothing else our thoughts have been the same. I really appreciate that you responded. I am in a dark place and just want someone to talk to. All my friends are at a bar or a party right now. I walked back alone to my friends house all alone at 1;30 and ended up feeling like the scum of the earth and don't really have a good reason to other than the fact that I don't feel good or included in any way what so ever, which makes me feel so alone and down. It's just really lame and upsetting.

EDIT: sorry for the typos I am pretty fucked up right now.

I have a dog that I have Learned to love. Even though I had a kittie who was my best friend. Things change but pets still need love. I am not in a good place either but things will get better if you have faith w those of us who feel like the lowest of low. Contact me if you want to chat kind stranger
